items.text: a good concept but without one glance tap widget, within days, I'll stop opening the app all together even when I am doing my tasks. so basically it will become useless.
So far so good. The visual data helps very much in what I want to track. Simple interface and easy to use. Perfect for what I need it for. Thank you
A great, minimalist habit tracking app. Doesn't overload you with things and keeps it simple.

After downloading more than twenty habit trackers, each of which had a problem, such as not having a yearly chart, or having to pay for useful features, or not having a nice user interface, or not having a widget, I finally found this app, which is so great.👍 but The user interface and widgets could be better.
Simple, Detailed and Cool App. with just enough customisations.

Great app, free simple, useful, statistics, only complaint is the widgets dont match theme or have settings to change color, and there isnt a widget 'button' to complete a specific task. Besides that, amazing app!

I just downloaded habitgrid, and so far: it seems like it's literally everything I wanted in a habit/routine app. I love how simple yet conventionally costumizable it is. and a BIG (but not the only) reason why I think I'm sticking to this app is that it's free. that's a big issue that me, and others, have with habit apps. this app seems authentic and I really value that. I'm excited to see upgrades since this seems like a relatively new (and already amazing) app! :)
provided premium features in free great 👍🏻
Extremely good app but I want you to add the feature of making a habit repeat on particular days of the week. Until I get this feature, I have to just be using habatica.

simple, clean ui, and does exactly what i want it to do. my only complaint is that you can only set one time for a notification reminder per habit, which isn't helpful for tasks that you want to repeat multiple times in one day. otherwise its great
